treatment: Treat as unconfirmed until NVIDIA publishes model details, a model card, weights, or a formal release schedule. Repeat only for official confirmation or another material factual delta.
known_facts: The Information, relayed by Reuters, reported that NVIDIA is developing a Nemotron 4 family.
The report says the largest model is expected to have at least 1 trillion parameters and could be ready as early as late fall.
NVIDIA confirmed it is working on Nemotron 4 but did not confirm the reported parameter count or timing.
reinclude_only_if: NVIDIA officially confirms parameter count, architecture, training status or release date.
Weights, model card, API availability or benchmarks are published.
Credible reporting materially changes the expected scope or timing.
notes: High-signal development report; core details remain unconfirmed by NVIDIA.
